capabilities: Stream agentic chat responses into the sidebar
Read, write, edit and search vault files
Attach notes, selections and external folders with @ mentions
Rewrite selected text inline with a diff preview
Run slash commands, skills, subagents and MCP servers
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Linux, Windows; Windows arm64 unsupported) and needs Obsidian 1.7.2+. No API key is requested; sign-in is handled by the local CLI. Bash mode is opt-in under Experimental settings, and feedback reports are only sent when the user submits them.
intentEvidence: Qoderian started from this MIT-licensed project
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a coding agent that can act directly on vault files and shell commands.

relations.evidence: Qoderian started from this MIT-licensed project
An Obsidian plugin that embeds Qoder CLI (qodercli) in your vault.

summary: Sidebar chat that runs the Qoder CLI agent inside the vault, letting it read, write, search files and run shell commands.
